title: CaseGraphen MCP host: memory_query / memory_explain / memory_history / memory_conflicts / memory_sources payload
description: The literal `payload.memory_request` an MCP client sends for the read-only memory tools: memory_query, memory_explain, memory_history, memory_conflicts, memory_sources. The host refuses at runtime (invalid_payload) if `claim_id` is absent for memory_explain, memory_history, or memory_sources; it is unused by memory_query and memory_conflicts. That per-tool requirement is not expressible in this schema, since one contract serves five tools.
